answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the violet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the gale re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the ledge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
